title: The First Observer's Choice
next_chapter_hook: The first path is observation, the second path is resistance, but where does the fourth path lead? When the First Observer's will flooded into Chen Ji's Mental Sea, he understood—he was about to touch upon a taboo older than Heavenly Dao itself.

text.content: As the guardians of the three paths quarreled endlessly, an unprecedented rune surfaced in the depths of Chen Ji's Mental Sea—a fourth path that even Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned. The rune displayed an eerie bronze hue, its surface flowing with patterns entirely different from the Tianji Record. The moment it touched Chen Ji's soul, the flickering life lamp in his Mental Sea suddenly blazed, erupting with dazzling golden-white light.

dialogue.content: "...Impossible!" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul shuddered violently—this was the first time Chen Ji had seen him so rattled. The shadow always shrouded within the pages actually condensed into a form, and the murky old eyes were filled with disbelief. "The fourth path has been sealed for three thousand years—how could it manifest now? Unless... he himself chose you."

text.content: The rune in his Mental Sea exploded abruptly, countless scenes flooding into Chen Ji's consciousness like a tide. He witnessed a grand altar, a disheveled figure driving both hands into his own chest, and those eyes—eyes connected to his blood yet utterly unfamiliar. The First Observer. His face was aged yet resolute, a peaceful smile playing at the corners of his lips, as if he had long foreseen this day.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji felt a violent wave of dizziness, his knees buckling involuntarily, nearly causing him to collapse. Gritting his teeth, he gripped his thighs tightly, forcing himself to maintain composure. Cold sweat traced down his spine, soaking his inner garments. He sneered internally: What's this? Trying to intimidate me before we've even met? Yet in the next instant, an ancient, gentle voice resonated directly within his soul: "Young friend, do not be alarmed. I bear you no ill will."

text.content: That voice carried boundless vicissitudes, as if having witnessed the complete cycle from the universe's birth to all things' extinction. Immediately, countless scenes flashed before Chen Ji's eyes like a carousel—he observed how the First Observer obtained the Tianji Record, how he gradually deciphered the truths of fate, and most critically, the world-shocking decision he made thirty thousand years ago. He chose to merge with Heavenly Dao's source. Not death, but fusion.

dialogue.content: "Fusion?" Chen Ji's voice was dry and hoarse, his throat rolling. "You're saying... you didn't die? You sacrificed yourself to Heavenly Dao?" A light laugh echoed in his soul, carrying a philosophical detachment that transcended worldly matters: "That word 'sacrifice' sounds rather unpleasant, young friend. I simply found another path—since Heavenly Dao forbids seers to exist, I chose to become part of Heavenly Dao."

text.content: The scenes in his Mental Sea continued to flow. Chen Ji witnessed the First Observer standing before Heavenly Dao's source, surrounded by countless threads of karma. His form began to transparent, to decompose, to merge into that dazzling radiance. However, at the final moment, he sealed a wisp of his will into the fourth page of the Tianji Record. That was the fourth path—transcending the Observer, transcending the Seer, even transcending Heavenly Dao—a path no one had ever walked.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled even more violently, nearly dissipating from the pages. He murmured to himself, voice carrying an unprecedented tremor: "Master... so you were here all along... You didn't abandon us. You were protecting the inheritors of the Tianji Record in another way..." Chen Ji cast a sidelong glance at him, a playful arc curling at the corner of his mouth: "So you knew all along, yet kept it from me?"

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment before finally sighing: "I truly did not know the entire truth. I only knew that Master left a remnant intention at the end, instructing me to protect the next inheritor of the Tianji Record. As for this fourth page—even I cannot access it." Chen Ji harrumphed coldly: "Noted." His tone was terrifyingly calm, yet it sent a bone-deep chill through Mo Xiansheng. These three words were more chilling than any threat.

text.content: The voice in his soul spoke again, this time with a hint of apology: "Young friend, do not blame him. I deliberately concealed this. I needed a pure Observer—without any preconceptions, without any expectations. And you—you alone fit the criteria." Chen Ji's brow furrowed as he asked coldly: "What criteria?"

dialogue.content: "Chosen by Heavenly Dao, yet abandoned by it; possessing prophetic powers, yet cursed by fate; destined to walk alone, yet unwilling to abandon anyone." The ancient voice paused. "Young friend, do you know what is the most painful thing in this world?" Chen Ji fell silent. "The most painful thing is not having no choices, but having too many—yet every single one leads to loss."

text.content: The scenes in his Mental Sea shifted abruptly. Chen Ji witnessed what happened after the First Observer merged with Heavenly Dao's source—he had become a single thread among countless strands of karma, silently observing the vicissitudes of heaven and earth. He watched his inheritors fall one by one, witnessed the Tianji Record change hands repeatedly, saw countless ambitious schemers attempt to lay hands on this taboo artifact. Thirty thousand years. He had旁观了整整三万年.

dialogue.content: "Why didn't you intervene?" Chen Ji's voice carried a tremor—this was unlike his usual cold demeanor. "You had that ability! You could have changed everything!" "Because that was not my path." The First Observer's voice remained calm, yet carried unwavering resolve. "An Observer's duty is to record, not to rewrite. If I forcibly intervened, I would have violated the rules by which Heavenly Dao operates." Chen Jiscoffed一声: "Rules? Are Heavenly Dao's rules themselves correct?"

choice.prompt: The First Observer's words seemed to contain profound meaning, and Chen Ji needed to make his first response—

choices.description: Heavenly Dao's rules are meant to be broken. The First Observer's choice to merge with Heavenly Dao was cowardice, not transcendence.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the First Observer's remnant will
choices.visible_reward: Reveal the essential difference between the first path and the fourth path
choices.risk_hint: If the remnant will is angered, the inheritance opportunity may be lost

text.content: A mocking arc curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth: "Thirty thousand years of observation? Laughable. This is not transcendence—it is escape." His voice was ice-cold and sharp. "You claim you chose to merge with Heavenly Dao, yet watched passively as your descendants died one by one, as the Tianji Record became a tool for schemers—is this your so-called duty?"

choices.description: Since he chose to reveal himself at this moment, there must be profound meaning. Listen quietly for details, perhaps gaining more crucial information.
choices.visible_reward: Fully understand the first Observer's intention
choices.risk_hint: If the other party does not trust you, they may only reveal partial information

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the restlessness in his heart and took a deep breath. He closed his eyes, swallowing back those sharp words. When he opened his eyes again moments later, his gaze had returned to its usual calmness and depth. '...Please continue, Senior.' The elderly voice seemed to show a satisfied smile: 'Good, young friend truly has the ability to stay composed.'

choices.text: Ask about the nature of the Fourth Path
choices.description: The other three paths are already clear, only the Fourth Path has never appeared. This is the most critical information to understand at present.
choices.visible_cost: May appear impatient and overly eager for quick success
choices.visible_reward: Directly obtain key information about the Fourth Path
choices.risk_hint: If the other party believes your motives are impure, they may refuse to disclose information

text.content: Chen Ji had no time to accompany him in reminiscing about the past, so he asked directly: 'What is the Fourth Path?' A light laugh echoed in his soul: 'Young friend is indeed pragmatic. You've seen the First, Second, and Third Paths—observation, resistance, fusion. Then the Fourth Path...' He paused, his voice becoming unusually solemn, 'is rewriting.'

Regardless of Chen Ji's choices, that elderly voice continued speaking slowly. He saw the final moments of the first Observer—before merging into the Heavenly Dao's origin, he had sealed a strand of will into the fourth page of the Tianji Record. Not to pass on power, but to wait for a person. Someone who could truly walk the Fourth Path.

dialogue.content: 'Wait.' Chen Ji suddenly interrupted, his brow furrowed tightly. 'You said you're waiting for a person. But you've been merged with the Heavenly Dao for thirty thousand years. How did you know I would appear?' 'Because I've already seen it.' The first Observer's voice was terrifyingly calm. 'Before you, seven thousand three hundred and twenty-one people touched the Tianji Record. I saw them all, but none were that person. Until you—'

text.content: Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill. Seven thousand three hundred and twenty-one people. Those who had touched the Tianji Record before—what were their fates? What were their endings? 'They all died.' The elderly voice carried no emotionalfluctuation at all. 'Either from Heavenly Dao's backlash, or from the Tianji Record's curse, or they exhausted everything pursuing the truth.' Chen Ji fell silent. He suddenly understood why the first Observer had waited so long, why he had been so cautious in choosing an inheritor.

dialogue.content: 'You chose me because I have that 'qualification'?' 'No.' The first Observer's voice carried a smile for the first time, 'I chose you because you're ruthless, cold, and intelligent—and more importantly, you have a fatal weakness.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly. 'Your sister.' The voice spoke word by word, 'Chen Nian.'

choice.prompt: The first Observer mentioned Chen Nian—Chen Ji's greatest weakness. At this moment, Chen Ji's heart was surely churning with massive waves. He needs to respond—

choices.description: If he knows Chen Nian's whereabouts but didn't say so earlier, he has ulterior motives. Chen Ji will not allow anyone to use his sister as a chess piece.
choices.visible_cost: May completely infuriate the remnant consciousness
choices.visible_reward: Force out more information about Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: If the other party closes the communication channel, he will lose the important inheritance

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze suddenly turned ice-cold and piercing. He spoke slowly, his voice terrifyingly calm: 'If you dare touch a single hair on her, I will turn these thirty thousand years of yours into a joke.' That was not a threat, but a promise.

choices.text: Calmly inquire about the truth of Chen Nian
choices.description: Anger won't solve the problem. If he knows about Chen Nian, there must be a connection. Let him finish first.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the core truth about Chen Nian's relationship with the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: If the information volume is too large, it may shake Chen Ji's judgment

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the churning emotions in his heart.

His voice returned to its usual calm: "...Do you know where she is?"

"Not only do I know where she is." The aged voice carried a hint of sighing. "I also know why she became the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.'"

choices.description: Why would an existence that has waited for ten thousand years suddenly appear now? There must be an ulterior motive.
choices.visible_reward: See through the opponent's possible schemes
choices.risk_hint: If the other party is indeed well-intentioned, it would appear as calculating a gentleman's mind with a petty person's heart

text.content:
Chen Ji's lips curved into a cold smile: "You waited thirty thousand years, selected over seven thousand people, and none satisfied you. Now you suddenly appear on your own and mention my sister— isn't that a bit too convenient?"

His gaze was sharp as a blade: "What exactly do you want?"

No matter what choice Chen Ji made, the First Observer's voice never stopped. He continued narrating that sealed truth— about Chen Nian, about the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, about why she became an existence that interfered with the Tianji Record's foresight.

Chen Ji's fists had unconsciously clenched tight, his knuckles white.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Nian——"

Chen Ji murmured the name, his knuckles cracking from the excessive force. His eye sockets were slightly reddened, but he quickly suppressed that wave of emotion.

"Continue."

Only these two words, yet heavy as a thousand junns.

text.content:
"The Heavenly Fate Lock Key is an existence created by the Heavenly Dao to oppose the prophet."

The First Observer's voice grew heavy. "Whenever someone tries to foresee a future containing Chen Nian, that foresight becomes blurred, even completely distorted. She is like a walking loophole, naturallyrestrained the power of the Tianji Record."

Chen Ji closed his eyes. His sister, who should have been his blood-connected loved one, had been marked by the Heavenly Dao as a 'key' since birth.

What kind of fate is this? What kind of justice is this?

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul listened quietly nearby, and finally couldn't help but speak: "Teacher, since you knew all this long ago, why not directly tell the successive inheritors? If they knew they were 'chess pieces' selected by the Heavenly Dao, perhaps they wouldn't——"

"Wouldn't what?" There was a hint of bitterness in the First Observer's voice. "Wouldn't be filled with resentment? Wouldn't become enemies of the Heavenly Dao? Wouldn't walk toward that destined tragedy?"

He sighed: "The more one knows, the heavier the burden. I only wanted those who came after to walk a slightly easier path."

text.content:
Chen Ji let out a cold laugh: "Easier? You let over seven thousand people die in confusion— is that your compassion?"

He didn't wait for an answer, continuing: "I don't care what your purpose is. Since you chose me, hand over all your cards."

He raised his head, his gaze sharp as a blade: "About the Fourth Path, about Chen Nian, about the Eye of the Heavenly Dao— I want to know everything."

dialogue.content:
A long silence spread through the Mental Sea.

When that voice sounded again, it carried unprecedented solemnity: "Very well. Since you asked, I will tell you everything."

"The Fourth Path is called 'Rewrite.' Not observation, not resistance, not fusion— but to completely overthrow and rewrite the entire operating rules of the Heavenly Dao."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

"This, is the path I did not complete in my time."

text.content:
The moment the words fell, the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's Mental Sea shook violently.

The originally incomplete fourth page began to slowly reveal golden characters, each stroke carrying ancient and profound power. As the text appeared, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented force flowing along some connection into his divine soul.

It was all the memories and insights accumulated over thirty thousand years by the First Observer, the ultimate legacy left after he comprehended the operating rules of the Heavenly Dao.

Chen Ji's body trembled violently, his bones, meridians, and divine soul all crackling under the scourging of this force. Mo Xiansheng exclaimed and tried to intervene, but was blocked by an invisible barrier.

The inheritance had already begun.

Once started, it could not be interrupted.

choice.prompt: The First Observer's inheritance was flooding into the Mental Sea, and Chen Ji had to make one final critical decision—

choices.description: Since it has already begun, there is no retreat. Endure everything, then become stronger.
choices.visible_cost: May suffer divine soul damage due to excessive information volume
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete inheritance and power of the First Observer
choices.risk_hint: If divine soul strength is insufficient, may permanently damage the foundation

text.content:
Chen Ji gritted his teeth, allowing that force to scour his divine soul.

Pain.

An indescribable agony came from the depths of his soul, as if ten million needles were simultaneously piercing into him. His consciousness began to blur, his body swaying.

But he did not fall.

"Is this all..." He managed to挤出 several words through clenched teeth, even forcing a ferocious smile. "Not enough!"

choices.description: Don't bite off more than you can chew. Rather than accepting everything and causing divine soul collapse, it's better to select the most critical parts.
choices.visible_cost: May miss critical information or power
choices.visible_reward: Maintain divine soul integrity, leaving room for the future
choices.risk_hint: If the wrong critical information is chosen, one may encounter a bottleneck later on.

text.content: Chen Ji forced himself tocalm down, searching for critical information nodes within that surging power. He abandoned most of the combat technique inheritances, focusing all his mind on one direction—about Chen Nian, about the Heavenly Fate Key, about how to remove the curse upon her. This was the only thing he could not abandon.

choices.description: This was not the inheritance he wanted. He had his own path to walk, needing no inheritance arranged by others.
choices.visible_cost: May completely lose this opportunity for inheritance
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent will, carve out a truly own path
choices.risk_hint: If the inheritance is interrupted, it may cause the Tianji Record to backfire

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, a thunderous roar echoing through his Mental Sea: "Enough!" His divine soul violently contracted, forcibly pushing back the inheritance power. This was not a simple resistance, but a clash between his own will and thirty thousand years of accumulated power. "I will forge my own path," his voice cold and resolute, "I don't need your charity."

Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, when that power gradually subsided, he found himself within a strange space. All around was an endless starry sky, and before him stood a blurry figure. It was the remnant soul of the first observer—or rather, a projection of will he had left behind thirty thousand years ago. "Young friend, you have done well." The figure slowly turned, revealing an aged yet benevolent face. His gaze at Chen Ji carried both appreciation and anticipation.

dialogue.content: "I don't have much time left." The first observer's voice grew faint, "This remnant consciousness is about to dissipate. But before the end, I want to tell you something." Chen Ji watched him silently, saying nothing. "True freedom—" the aged voice spoke word by word, "is not escaping the chessboard, but rewriting the rules." The moment the words fell, that figure began slowly dissolving, turning into dots of starlight that merged into Chen Ji's divine soul.

text.content: Chen Ji reached out his hand, wanting to grasp something, yet only caught emptiness. In that moment, he suddenly felt an indescribable loneliness. Thirty thousand years of waiting, just to entrust hope to an unfamiliar descendant. What did this obsession, this perseverance, count for? He didn't know the answer. But he knew, from now on, he was no longer alone.

dialogue.content: "The inheritance is complete..." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted over, his voice trembling, "Teacher... can finally rest in peace." Chen Ji said nothing, standing quietly in place,消化着识海中新增的信息. After a moment, he slowly spoke: "Mo Xiansheng, I still have questions about the fourth path." Mo Xiansheng was slightly taken aback, then smiled ruefully: "Young friend wants to ask about the Eye of Heavenly Dao, yes?"

text.content: Chen Ji nodded, a cold gleam flickering in his eyes. The first observer's memory told him that the Eye of Heavenly Dao was no ordinary existence. It was the materialization of Heavenly Dao's operating rules, the final destination for every prophet—being assimilated by Heavenly Dao, becoming part of it. The first observer had chosen to merge with Heavenly Dao back then precisely to find methods to oppose it from within. And now, this task had fallen upon Chen Ji's shoulders.

Within his Mental Sea, the first observer's testament echoed like a great bell: "True freedom, not escaping the chessboard, but rewriting the rules." Chen Ji opened his eyes, his pitch-black pupils reflecting the endless starry sea. From this moment, he was no longer merely an observer, nor a blind rebel. What he intended to do was overthrow this chess game that had persisted for billions of years, personally rewrite the operating laws of this heaven and earth. And his first step would begin with Chen Nian.

Around Chen Ji, the fourth page of the Tianji Record finally fully manifested. It was a blank page, but when Chen Ji placed his palm upon it, characters began slowly emerging—words only he could understand, recording the true essence of the fourth path. "The Rewriter must gather three things: the Tianji Record Fragment, the Heavenly Fate Key, and the Heart of Heavenly Dao." Chen Ji read these words softly, his brow slightly furrowing. He already had three pages of the Tianji Record Fragment, and the Heavenly Fate Key was Chen Nian. As for the Heart of Heavenly Dao... He needed more information.

Just then, Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again: "Young friend, regarding the Heart of Heavenly Dao, I might know some clues." Chen Ji turned to look at him, his gaze calm: "Speak." "Within the Ancient Forbidden Land behind the three major sects, it is said a divine artifact from primordial times is sealed. Successive sect leaders have attempted to find it, yet none have succeeded." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul flickered, "If this old man guesses correctly, that should be the Heart of Heavenly Dao." Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then a meaningful smile curved his lips. "Ancient Forbidden Land... It seems I must make a trip to the Xuanwu Sect."

Just as Chen Ji contemplated his next move, the Tianji Record suddenly shook violently. A familiar aura drifted in from the distance—it was Su Qingyao. Her voice was urgent and tense: "Chen Ji! Where are you? Something big happened!" Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly as he withdrew from his Mental Sea. Before him, the Tianji Record floated in the air, the text on the fourth page still glowing faintly. "What's wrong?" "Tianqing Sect... is being besieged!" Su Qingyao's voice carried unprecedented panic, "Xuanwu Sect has united with the other two major sects, using 'pursuing demonic path spies' as an excuse, blocking the entire sect!" Chen Ji's gaze instantly turned cold.

"'Pursuing demonic path spies'?" Chen Ji coldly laughed, "What an impressive display." He tucked the Tianji Record into his sleeve, striding outward. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul spoke softly behind him: "Young friend, this is aimed at you." "I know." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, "Han Lie, that fool, has finally made his move." A mocking smile curved his lips: "But does he think this can trap me? How naive."

Chen Ji stepped out of the secret chamber, the blinding sunlight making him squint slightly. In the distance, from the direction of Tianqing Sect's Mountain Gate, faint commotion and Spiritual Energy fluctuations could be heard. He didn't hesitate in the slightest, his figure flashing as he headed toward that direction. Three sects surrounding? Pursuing spies? It was merely self-entertainment by a bunch of clowns. Now that Chen Ji had obtained the first observer's complete inheritance, he would no longer fear any challenge. Han Lie, you want to play? Then I'll play this game to the end. A cold gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as his form vanished like lightning at the end of the Mountain Path.

The first path is observation, the second path is resistance, but where does the fourth path lead? When Chen Ji's figure appeared at Tianqing Sect's Plaza, disciples from the three major sects all turned to look. They gazed at this disciple ranked as "waste" among the Servant Disciples, eyes filled with contempt and disdain. Yet they didn't know that the one standing before them was no longer that Chen Ji who could be bullied at will. The complete memory and power inheritance of the first observer were slowly awakening within his Mental Sea. A storm sufficient to overturn the entire cultivation world was about to arrive.
